Quản Lý Đầu Đốt Lò Hơi

Definition

The control and monitoring of burner operations on marine boilers to ensure safe and efficient ignition, combustion, and shut-down sequences.

Operational example

Check boiler burner management system status before lighting off and during shut-down, confirming all safety interlocks and alarms are operational.
